title: I'm an architect making an architecture RPG using AI
author: PigeonHeadArc
selftext: It's a deck builder roguelike. I'm still in the prototype phase. Maybe I rambled a bit too much in this video lol, but I didn't haven't a script, just wanted to share where I'm at right now with the game. Happy to answer all questions and listen to all feedback.

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: lol hopefully this is a good critique haha

replies.author: Time_Cat_5212
replies.body: needs more arch school jargon, like... "materiality" "architectonic" "formgiving"

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: Really? I'll consider it. I didn't' want to step too far away from the "casual" game style.

replies.author: Time_Cat_5212
replies.body: imo your best target audience is arch students.  they'll be crazy about this, it could actually be a fad.  most people don't get it lol

comments.author: rapkannibale
comments.body: This is why I love AI it allows people who would not be able to make a game express their creativity through this medium. Keep going!

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: I totally agree! I mostly use AI for my business but last week I got curious. I love games, but can't game too much cause of my limited time. This new "hobby" has replaced gaming for me in the short term. It's so fun!

comments.author: Material_Control_989
comments.body: jajajajaja, es como una corrección de vieja escuela (que recuerdos... también soy arquitecto y estuve ahi Gandalf, hace 3000 años...). Yo estoy haciendo un juego basado en Robotech con IA... intenté alejarme de la arquitectura así y terminé haciendo ciudades procedurales, arquitecturas alienigeneas, y mapas urbanos gigantes con integración a sistemas GIS...

comments.body:
why this sub has so many losers downvoting this.

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: I’m new , perhaps I broke a rule.

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: haha! funny you say that, this weekend I had an idea that if I progress far enough, I'd like to take the core concept and make a Pico version of it. One of the thoughts was that it would not be an AutoCAD UI, but it would be reminicent of the early days of CAD, like early 90's. So maybe! I still have to learn more about the limitations of Pico
